name: Yamaha GT80 / JT1 Mini Enduro
engine: 58 to 72 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, Autolube oil injection
intro: Yamaha's mini enduros for kids. Rotary-valve or piston-port two-strokes with Autolube and lights.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
